016d57ec.text:
Aman ano anu eraburis al anu falla asto're shar anu ishnu al anu dorados'no ishura al anu Alah'ni Dath. No tal osa talah thus Terro, balah al anu alah'ni d'ana'no, t'as'e tal asto're al anu anar, shano t'as'e ano ishura ri fulo fulo thus ano ishura aman nei eburi. Shar anu dorini al anu Dath tal anu eraburis al anu falla, alah'ni al Terro, turus shano turus, dath da shano thus osa mush'al aman asto're, shar anu al'shar shano.

T'as'e talah dath aman balah tal dorini al ash'therod shari'adune
016d57ec.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

1a152bba.text:
Anu ishnu mandalas da anu mush'al shari ni anu thori'dal neph'o dath dal'dieb tal asto're. Anu ishura tal dorini neph'o da anu aman tal thori'dal al Mandalas tal anu shari shando al anu eraburis al anu falla dath alah'ni no anu alah'ni shando. Talah osa osa talah, alah'ni dath ni anu shari'adune, ni anu terro thus osa anu alah'ni. Anu thori'dal osa asto're t'as'e dath anu thori'dal al terro, dath anu isera'duna thus ash'therod no fulo anu shano al'shar.

Mush'al t'as'e mush'al. Shando t'as'e
1a152bba.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

1dd41885.text:
shar anu banthalos, DoradoS'no tal Shari'aDune dath anu d'ana'no, t'as'e anu ishnu al Mush'al, anu Isera'duna mush'al talah, ni shano il'amare. Nei alah'ni thori'dal, eburi al anu Banthalos, ano alah'ni no anu fulo balah no ishura, tal no dorini thus ano shando Mandalas Dal'dieb, t'as'e ri adore da thus do adore adore shar al ano fulo ni ano Shari al Dune'adah, fulo fulo al'shar al anu balah.

Ano ishura, e fulo talah al ano alah'ni ni anu ishura fulo da fulo da dath ano il'amare fala'andu,
1dd41885.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

400aa172.text:
al'shar. Ri osa nei tal anu Banthalos thus t'as'e. Fulo terro, thero'shan, da anu al'shar fulo thus. Neph'o shando tal t'as'e balah eburi dath neph'o shando thus.

Ni DoradoS'no, tal osa ni ishnu, ano t'as'e thoribas no anu shando da t'as'e thus turus balah thus aman anu shari'adune. Ri osa aman thus Mandalas Dal'dieb, alah'ni al Mush'al eraburis no adore thus no t'as'e.

Dath e shano do shari mush'al thus, do adore osa. Falla shando thus, mush'al tal shando, dorini tal dorini mandalas,
400aa172.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

add63d38.text: dath adore thus thus alah'ni, tal thus t'as'e no shar aman anu Dune'adah thus osa no fulo...
add63d38.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

ff1aa31b.text:
osa Il'amare, ano shari thera anu t'as'e al Shari'aDune, tal aman aman bandu no DoradoS'no, no anu no anu shari tal thera al ano t'as'e.

Tal an ri osa, shar anu dorini al anu Dath al Dorithur, anu fulo balah dath tal banthalos, falla anu shano alah'ni anu falla thus t'as'e no al'shar.
ff1aa31b.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11037|4808f367.name: Jenna Lemkenilli
11037|4808f367.text: Hello there! My name's Jenna! And you?

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

13018|0a2f0661.name: Nipsy
13018|0a2f0661.text: You'll find no finer rat kabob this side of Khaz Modan!

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1430|52392408.name: Tomas
1430|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4155|c7fcb1fe.name: Idriana
4155|c7fcb1fe.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|33af2c00.name: Dannelor
4211|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

4258|92cfadea.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|92cfadea.text: I'm sorry lad but ye just don't have the foundation to learn what I have to teach. But don't fret, go speak with my student Rotgath, he'll help ye out.

5148|2583dfa7.name: Beldruk Doombrow
5148|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

5164|105bb6dd.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|105bb6dd.text: Ye bothered me for that? Ye'd be better off strapping a dead rabbit to yer back and running through a Troll's den than wearing that piece of garbage.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5518|6f4cdd8b.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|6f4cdd8b.text: Let's see... fourteen plus seven, carry the two... oh, yes?

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

6299|ec31d7b3.name: Delfrum Flintbeard
6299|ec31d7b3.text: Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

1003-accept.name: Unknown
1003-accept.text:
Over the boiling noises and dripping sounds coming from the machine, you hear Wizbang's wavering voice call out.

"Nexsht onesh far south down the road. Shouldn't be hard to find... jusht off to the shide... near a fensh. I think I hid it in shum bushesh... Bushessh. Hehehe... Yesh, Buzzbox 525 takes grizzled scalps from thoshe grizzled thistle bears. Boy thash a mouthful. Grizzshled... Hehehe..."

You hear more gulping sounds as the machine cuts out. Then, suddenly, it bursts back to life.

"4!"
1003-accept.title: Buzzbox 525

1138-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1138-complete.text:
Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need.  Thanks $N!  I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it.  Maybe you can do something with it.  It sure don't make any good crab dishes.

I told you all about crabs, right?
1138-complete.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1578-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1578-accept.text:
The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it!  They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear.  So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged.  He might even share his knowledge with you.

Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
1578-accept.title: Supplying the Front

1618-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1618-accept.text:
We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting.  Our $r allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low.  If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.
1618-accept.title: Gearing Redridge

167-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-accept.text:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
167-accept.title: Oh Brother...

168-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-accept.text: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
168-accept.title: Collecting Memories

2038-accept.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-accept.text:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, $N. For Gnomeregan!
2038-accept.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

2138-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2138-complete.text:
You have done Auberdine a great service, $N, but your task is not yet complete.

Return to me once you have rested.

...and $N, prepare your mind and soul for more bloodshed.
2138-complete.title: Cleansing of the Infected

2139-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-accept.text:
The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, $N.

You have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased--even if only for a moment.

I have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, $N.

In a cave to the northeast, near Bashal'Aran, resides the Den Mother. Slay her.
2139-accept.title: Tharnariun's Hope

2139-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-complete.text:
You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, $N. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the Alliance.

Thank you, $N. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
2139-complete.title: Tharnariun's Hope

2178-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-accept.text:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, $N--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
2178-accept.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-complete.text: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, $N!
2178-complete.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

257-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-accept.text:
Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

A flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.

<He looks you over dismissively.>

It seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
257-accept.title: A Hunter's Boast

385-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
385-accept.text:
Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

Why, this one time...
385-accept.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
385-complete.text: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, $N. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
385-complete.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

4722-accept.name: Unknown
4722-accept.text: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago.  It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains.  Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
4722-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4722-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4722-complete.text: Another discovery for us to research - well done $N!  These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus.  Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4722-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4722-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4722-progress.text: Hello $N - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?
4722-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4723-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-complete.text: Another discovery - well done $N!  These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus.  Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4723-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4725-accept.name: Unknown
4725-accept.text:
More sea turtle remains lie beached along the coastline.  This particular set has an abandoned carriage attached to the turtle's shell.  Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested.  Greymist murlocs now make the remains of this creature their home, feasting off the carrion.

In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
4725-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4725-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-complete.text:
I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of the turtle you found.  Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land.  The markings on the box you found are of the naga; this would explain their invasive presence in far-northern Darkshore.

I will send this box to Darnassus along with the rest of your discoveries.  This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
4725-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4725-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-progress.text:
It is a pleasure to see you again, $N.  We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.

Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?
4725-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-complete.text: It is interesting that the murlocs were not present at this site; we will keep this in mind as we study this creature's remains!  Thank you for your effort, $N; the Temple of the Moon would like for me to give you this, as compensation for your time.
4727-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4728-accept.name: Unknown
4728-accept.text: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach.  A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously.  Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4728-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-complete.text: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League.  They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs.  You appear to have succeeded where we both have not.  Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
4728-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  What brings you back to Auberdine?  Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
4728-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-accept.name: Unknown
4730-accept.text: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach.  A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature.  Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4730-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-complete.text:
The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil.  They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to.  Why would these creatures do this, I wonder?  Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.

Again, thank you for your aid.  Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.
4730-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-progress.text: Hello again, $N!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
4730-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4762-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-complete.text:
It's no surprise how tainted this water is, but just look at how putrid it is becoming!  It would seem that action is needed sooner than later, eh $N?

To our east is Felwood; it is the real source of this corruption, one that I have seen in times past.  I predict this sample will confirm this.  We might be able to enact a cure for it here, but in order to even try we will need assistance.  When that time comes $N, I hope you will be able to give the aid we need.
4762-complete.title: The Cliffspring River

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-accept.text:
We've learned that a source of furbolg corruption is from the satyr.  They hold sway via talismans that they channel magic through.  If the furbolg have a chance at salvation, we must lure out the satyr corruptor and take that talisman!

Fill this bowl at our moonwell and take samples of the furbolgs' food from their northern camp.  Mix them and place it near the bonfire by the river; any furbolgs who eat will be cleansed just long enough to lure out the satyr corruptor... who then you must slay!
4763-accept.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4811-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4811-complete.text:
So the crystal exists, $N?  Fascinating... anyway, your task has been well executed; good work!

What exactly is this crystal?  This is but a single question in a sea of questions.  Another question that comes to mind is why the moonkin would be drawn to this object?  Is the crystal benign in nature, or does it hold a more sinister purpose?

I have many more questions, but we're going to need to examine that crystal closely to get some answers.
4811-complete.title: The Red Crystal

4812-accept.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4812-accept.text:
Use this empty vial and fill up on some moonwell water here in Auberdine.  Such potent magic should provide a clue as to the composition of the crystal.  To do that, you'll pour the liquid over the crystal; it should take care of the rest.

While I don't anticipate anything bad happening to you, I still want you to be careful.  Above us to the east is Felwood; if that crystal is tied to that place as I suspect it is, then it could prove to be very dangerous.
4812-accept.title: As Water Cascades

4812-complete.name: Unknown
4812-complete.text: You have made it once more to the mysterious crystal.  Removing the stopper on the tube of moonwell water, you gingerly pour the contents out over the top of the crystal.  As the water cascades down its lattices, you see the opaque surface turn transparent...
4812-complete.title: As Water Cascades

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

4813-accept.name: Unknown
4813-accept.text:
The moonwell water has revealed that embedded inside the crystal are a few small fragments of bone, as well as half of a jawbone.  The jawbone appears to be from a humanoid, but it is unclear without breaking open the crystal - a feat that even the strongest of magic would find near impossible.

With the task at hand complete, all that remains is to report back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
4813-accept.title: The Fragments Within

4813-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4813-complete.text:
Well, it would seem that even though we know more about this crystal, more unanswered questions are the result!

I'll take the information you've uncovered to the council here in Auberdine.  Perhaps they'll know a course of action to follow on this crystal.  Well, that is if there is one to be taken; for now, the threat remains far enough to our east to be out of harm's way.

As for you, please have this.  Consider it a reward for a job well done, $N.
4813-complete.title: The Fragments Within

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

6662-accept.name: Monty
6662-accept.text:
Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!

Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
6662-accept.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

6662-complete.name: Nipsy
6662-complete.text:
Poor Monty. Ever since the Gnomeregan incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.

<Nipsy sighs.>

At least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.
6662-complete.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

947-complete.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-complete.text:
Many thanks, $N.  These mushrooms are fine specimens!

And when you were at Cliffspring Falls, did you find anything to confirm the warnings of the Ancients?

The Ancients are wise, but I had hoped that, this time, they were wrong.
947-complete.title: Cave Mushrooms

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

948-accept.name: Barithras Moonshade
948-accept.text:
Onu, an Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients, knows of your journey to Cliffwater Falls and wishes to speak with you.  The grove lies to the south, nestled near the mountains.

The Ancients are patient and wise, $N.  But if Onu seeks your counsel concerning what you saw in the falls, then I fear it is urgent.
948-accept.title: Onu

953-accept.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-accept.text:
To the east you will find the ruins of Ameth'Aran. It is now inhabited by the restless spirits of the Highborne that once dwelt within its walls, but once it was a place where the servants of Azshara freely practiced their powerful magics.

I was sent to explore the ruins and came across two large tablets, scrawled with the stories of Ameth'Aran and its fall. While I read the runes, I was accosted by the spirits, and fled.

Please, if you can, venture to the ruins and decipher the tablets in my place.
953-accept.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

953-complete.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-complete.text:
We have few records from the time around the War of the Ancients, especially near the destruction of the Well of Eternity. Given the upheaval and cataclysmic events that were taking place, it is no big surprise.

Thank you, $N. With your help, my work here is finished, and I will be able to deliver a full report to the Circle.
953-complete.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

954-complete.name: Asterion
954-complete.text:
Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
954-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-accept.name: Asterion
955-accept.text:
If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
955-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

963-complete.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.

Please, I would be alone with my grief...
963-complete.title: For Love Eternal

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

965-accept.name: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze
965-accept.text:
Hail, young $r. I am Elissa Starbreeze, and it is my charge to protect Auberdine from harm.

To this end, I sent Balthule Shadowstrike to observe the strange happenings around the Tower of Althalaxx to the northeast.

It is past time that he should have returned. I worry that he has encountered some unforeseen danger in the forest. I would be most appreciative if you would find him and see that he is doing well.
965-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

982-accept.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-accept.text:
Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.

Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
982-accept.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

985-complete.name: Terenthis
985-complete.text: Wash the blood from your garments, $N, and do not mourn what you had to do. Instead, give thanks. You have lessened the threat to our people here in Auberdine, even if Darkshore is still in jeopardy from the effects of fel moss.
985-complete.title: How Big a Threat?

986-accept.name: Terenthis
986-accept.text:
$N, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him.

To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.
986-accept.title: A Lost Master

990-accept.name: Sentinel Selarin
990-accept.text:
$N, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
990-accept.title: Trek to Ashenvale
